name: limits
description: Claude Code mod: your 5h/7d quota, context window, prompt-cache time left and session cost on one line above the prompt, with per-subagent cost on hover

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: How long the main loop's prompt cache lives after its last response: 1h with extended caching, 5m otherwise

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: theme follows your Claude Code theme (light, dark, colour-blind); pastel is fixed colours tuned for dark terminals

costCommand.title: Cost split command
costCommand.description: Command that prints a session's cost split by main thread and subagent as JSON (see the README); the session id is appended. Empty: the cost hover shows the total only
